name: Liberty League Cross Country Championships
headline: Liberty League Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: RPI won its tenth straight men’s title with 18 points, ahead of Vassar (67) and St. Lawrence (106), and RPI’s Evan Lacey won the 8K in 24:54.7. Vassar won the women’s title with 31 points over St. Lawrence (58) and RPI (76), and Vassar’s Haley Schoenegge won the 6K in 21:19.8.
